event.transcript: Good morning everyone, and welcome to the conference. Today I want to talk about how we are making it easier to build production-ready agents. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gives you three core components: a runtime, a gateway, and memory. With AgentCore Runtime, each session runs in its own isolated microVM for up to eight hours. Last year, customers ran more than 1.5 billion inference requests on Amazon Bedrock. We are also announcing Graviton 5, which delivers up to 30 percent better price performance than Graviton 4. Our new foundation models support a context window of one million tokens. You can deploy inference endpoints across three Availability Zones to improve throughput and resilience. With Retrieval Augmented Generation, you can ground the model's responses in your own data. Amazon S3 Vectors reduces the cost of storing and querying vectors by up to 90 percent. Serverless inference means you only pay for the tokens you actually use. Latency matters. Our customers expect a time to first token of less than 200 milliseconds. So what does this mean for your architecture? First, start with a small evaluation set and measure before you optimize. Second, use Guardrails to keep your agents safe and compliant. Third, monitor everything with observability tools like Amazon CloudWatch. One customer reduced their deployment time from six weeks to four days. That is the power of building on a secure and scalable foundation. Thank you, and enjoy the rest of the conference.
